import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island label variant (strip whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Filter out out-of-range body_mass_g values (2500-6500 grams)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Keep only rows with valid sex (not missing)
    df = df[df['sex'].notna()]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
